messages:
Mona: Heads-up— quick thread to lock down alerting gates for the Optimize pilot. We agreed eval-triggered alerts P0. Need a compact, low-noise rollout plan we can ship to canary this week.

Ryan: Agree. Key risk is noise -> pages. Propose two-stage firing: 1) passive channel + suggested actions, 2) escalate if unresolved 30m. Also require a min-sample size window.

Tess: For UX: an alert card should show: failing eval name, baseline vs current metric, top-3 example inputs, suggested mitigation (rollback or config change), and an opt-out button per project. I can mock a card.

Priya: AC from PM side: 1) Alerts include eval snapshot + delta, 2) One-click rollback to previous model variant OR apply cached config suggestion, 3) Alerts have FP suppression (manual ack) and opt-out per project. Need copy for audit log.

Diego: Telemetry: require these metrics on canary: alert_count, alert_rate_per_route, avg_time_to_ack, rollback_count, suggested_action_accept_rate. Also include sampling of raw inference traces (10/min route) for 24h.

Lin: Runtime constraints: we should rate-limit alert generation per route to 1/min and aggregate identical alerts within 5m. Also add FP suppression rule: if same alert seen <10m after manual ack, do not page.

Mona: Good. Let's pick exact gating criteria for GA vs pilot. Proposal: Pilot (canary): alerts enabled passive-only, suggestions shown, no paging. GA: paging allowed for severity=high and after 3 repeated firings in 15m. Thoughts?

Ryan: Works. For severity definition: severity=high if perf drop >5% AND rerank delta >0.12 on a customer eval. Otherwise medium.

Tess: UX followups: we need runbook links in the alert; include suggested CLI rollback command and console button. I'll add small snippet: 
``
redwood rollback --project $P --route $R --model $OLD
```

Priya: Customer-facing mock alert text: 
"Alert: ACME_core eval failed. Fluency -3.6 pts. Suggested: rollback to v1.3 or increase cache TTL to 5m. View trace or opt-out"

Diego: Canary instrumentation: tag all canary alerts with `optimize:pilot` and collect samples to a dedicated index. Limit retention to 7d.

Mona: Action items: Tess -> mock card + runbook snippet (tomorrow EOD). Ryan -> implement rate-limit & aggregate logic (2d). Lin -> update paging rules in SRE playbook (3d). Diego -> telemetry dashboard template + retention (2d). Priya -> customer copy + AC checklist (1d). I'll own gate decisions and announce GA criteria.

deploy-bot: CI: optimize/alerts-canary v0.3 pushed to canary; smoke tests passed (24/24). Canary window 1h.

Ryan: Quick note: batching still P2 for pilot but we should expose an opt-in toggle `dynamic_batching=true` per project so power users can test.

Tess: Added toggle to mock UI list.

Mona: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock these action owners and schedule a 30m demo after canary finishes. React :thumbsup: if good.

Priya: :thumbsup:

Lin: :thumbsup:

Diego: :thumbsup:

Mona: Thanks team  will post the canary link + dashboard after deployment finishes.
